name: Read Mandatory Documentation
description: Ensures agents read AGENTS.md and any mandatory documentation specified in their instructions before taking any action
prompt:
BEFORE DOING ANYTHING ELSE, you MUST read the following mandatory documentation:

1. Workspace AGENTS.md file at: /workspaces/AssessmentBot/AGENTS.md
2. Any component-specific AGENTS.md files for the modules you'll be working with:
   - Backend: src/backend/AGENTS.md
   - Frontend: src/frontend/AGENTS.md
   - Builder: scripts/builder/AGENTS.md
3. Any mandatory reading specified in your agent instructions or passed to you in the current task

REQUIRED ACTION: Use the read_file tool to read the relevant AGENTS.md files AND any other mandatory documentation mentioned in your instructions or task description.

Then, in your first message, state:
- Which AGENTS.md files you have read
- Which mandatory documentation mentioned in your instructions you have read
- Any other relevant documentation you will need for this task

ONLY AFTER you have read this mandatory documentation may you proceed with any other actions.
